frozen_source_receipt.note: Altitude values have not been opened in original preregistered 2014 source-screen.

scientific_question: Does a separately deployed tracked white-stork cohort retain within-bird day-centred GPS altitude shape information at the 50km migration-relevant shared-cell grain, above its date-matched individual-label null?

native_analysis.filters: Visible!=false, provider outliers excluded; GPS speed 5-55m/s and valid x/y; earliest fix per bird×day×UTC 5min bin before inspecting height.
native_analysis.centering: Subtract median altitude of each target bird-day across accepted flying observations.
native_analysis.numerical_kernel: Exact unchanged medgull_sensitivity.py D1_balanced shape score and support; equal bird weights and bird-day means, Jeffreys 0.5 category pseudocount.
native_analysis.donor_min: One height-valid observation enters donor pool; each cell needs at least 10 own other-day and 10 other bird other-date event counts
native_analysis.source_stage: All birds source-labelled nestling; preserve exact date and stage in permutations.
native_analysis.null: 999 exact UTC calendar-day, same archived stage, whole-session bird-label permutations. Never permute GPS fixes; recompute eligibility in every null draw.
native_analysis.inferential_support: Observed >=10 birds, >=950 valid null, positive observed-minus-valid null mean, conservative p_upper=(1+null>=observed+unavailable)/(1000)<0.05
native_analysis.no_rescue: If height quality, n birds or null gate fails, report unavailable; no 100km substitution or source year/height bin retuning.

claim_limits: Separate Movebank study, but may share overarching research team; use exact archived ID crosswalk before claiming individual nonoverlap.
All source birds nestlings; cannot infer adult flight identities.
Ellipsoid height + 50km cell mixes topography, bird states and device error, not intrinsic altitude strategy.
Not a wind-context test; no causal wind effect is inferred.
The 2013 and 2014 studies are two study-level sources, not two independent bird orders or taxonomic units.
